_comment: Traducción al inglés de src/data/*.json. Solo los campos de texto: se mezclan por clave (objetos) y por posición (listas). Los proyectos van por id.

profile.headline: Websites, apps, bots, plugins and tools, built with care for the details.
profile.description: Portfolio of Domin, software developer: websites and apps in PHP, TypeScript and Flutter, bots, plugins and tools. Explore it as a 3D video game or in a classic version.
about: I'm Domin, a developer. I like building things that work well and look even better: web and mobile apps, bots, plugins for tools I use every day and command-line utilities.
This portfolio is an island you can explore like a video game, but it also has this classic version, fast and accessible. Every project has an interactive demo you can try.

highlights.title: Web and mobile apps
highlights.text: Management software for gyms, farms, building maintenance and hospitality, with PHP, React and Flutter.

highlights.title: Bots, plugins and agents
highlights.text: Plugins for Dispatcharr and for debuggers, Discord bots and semantic search over notes.

highlights.title: Hardware and tools
highlights.text: Firmware for an ESP32 display and command-line utilities, deployed with Docker on Linux.

clawdmeter.title: Clawdmeter Plus (custom version)
clawdmeter.description: AMOLED desk display with an ESP32-S3 that shows live Claude Code usage, the time, the weather and the status of several services, next to a pixel-art mascot. It's my custom version of an open-source project, with a much simpler install on Windows.
clawdmeter.credit: Based on Clawdmeter Plus by sorryhumans and Clawdmeter by Hermann Bjorgvin. Personal, unofficial project: not affiliated with Anthropic.
clawdmeter.note: The data shown in the demo is fictional.

studens.title: University matchmaking app
studens.description: Flutter mobile app with a swipe mechanic to connect with other students through shared interests, see campus events and chat in real time. Private project.
studens.note: Private repository. The demo profiles are fictional.

vs-immediate.title: vs-immediate: the Immediate Window for your AI agent
vs-immediate.description: Plugin that lets an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex) do what you do in the debugger's Immediate Window: evaluate expressions, inspect variables, the call stack, threads and exceptions, and control execution. Works with Visual Studio and JetBrains Rider.

auto-match.title: Auto Match All Channels (Dispatcharr plugin)
auto-match.description: Plugin that automates Dispatcharr's EPG Auto Match: it walks through the channels one by one using the same function as the single-channel button, with a group filter, live progress and a final summary, without freezing the interface.
auto-match.note: Demo channels and results are fictional.

elsaview.title: ElsaView: workflow monitoring dashboard
elsaview.description: Central dashboard, inspired by Portainer, to watch the health of several workflow-engine instances: alerts, execution history and server metrics. Includes agents with outbound connections for servers behind a VPN. Private project.
elsaview.note: Private repository. Demo servers and data are fictional.

ganaderia.title: Complete livestock farm management
ganaderia.description: Web application that tracks everything from the arrival of a delivery note until the animal is assigned to a pen, moved, lost or shipped: stock and weight per pen, losses and transfers with photo evidence, load planning and profitability simulation. PHP with an MVC architecture. Private project.
ganaderia.note: Private repository. The demo data is fictional.

mantenimiento.title: Building maintenance PWA
mantenimiento.description: Progressive web app to manage recurring building maintenance: assigned workers, tasks with forms and photos, and salt level and stock tracking with low-level alerts. React, TypeScript and Supabase. Private project.
mantenimiento.note: Private repository. Demo buildings and tasks are fictional.

fitpro.title: FITPro: complete gym management system
fitpro.description: Gym management platform with authentication, class scheduling, trainers, progress tracking, nutrition plans and an AI chatbot (Google Gemini API). PHP backend with an MVC architecture and an admin panel.
fitpro.note: Fictional classes. In the demo the coach answers from your browser; the project uses the Gemini API.

hosteleria.title: Digital ecosystem for restaurants (prototype)
hosteleria.description: Interactive prototype of a restaurant ecosystem: QR digital menu, kitchen display, waiter view and back office, with an order flow kept in sync across views. React with simulated in-memory state. Private project.
hosteleria.note: Private repository. Demo dishes and orders are fictional.

webscraping.title: Web scraping tool with XPath
webscraping.description: Web tool that extracts information from a page given a URL and an XPath expression, and shows the results in a table. HTML, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS.
webscraping.note: Sample pages are bundled; the XPath really runs in your browser.

atom.title: ATOM Processor: ATOM and RSS feed reader
atom.description: Web app that processes ATOM and RSS feeds (by URL or by pasting the XML) and shows them as cards or a list, with favourites saved in the browser.
atom.note: The sample feeds are fictional; the XML parsing is real.

pixelart.title: Image to pixel art converter
pixelart.description: Simple converter that turns an image into pixel art by adjusting the pixel size. It really works here: upload your image or use a sample, pick a palette and download it.

obsidian-rag.title: Obsidian RAG: chat with your notes
obsidian-rag.description: Turns an Obsidian vault and its documents (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV) into a knowledge base you can query in natural language: local semantic search with embeddings and ChromaDB, an MCP server for coding agents and an OpenAI-compatible API to chat from Open WebUI. Private project.
obsidian-rag.note: Private repository. The notes are fictional; the search really runs in your browser (TF-IDF instead of embeddings).

streambot.title: StreamBot Acestream: stream video to voice channels
streambot.description: Discord selfbot that streams videos, live streams and streaming links (including Acestream) to voice or video channels: local folder, YouTube search, arbitrary links and an event list. Based on StreamBot by ysdragon. Private project.
streambot.note: Private repository. Demo conversation is fictional.

hola.text: Meow! I'm Misu, this island's guide. Welcome to Domin's portfolio. Have you seen the robot in the square? It waves at everyone who walks by.

isla.text: The island has grown: there's a lighthouse, a stranded ship, plateaus you climb by ramps, a cave you can walk through, a chest half-buried on the beach… and an islet you can reach by swimming! The four fenced plots hold Domin's projects: walk up to each stand to try them.

domin.text: Domin is a developer who likes building all sorts of things: websites, bots, plugins and tools. This island shows them off without a boring CV.

camino.text: Stone paths leave the central crossroads and go around the island, and dirt trails branch off them towards the hidden corners. The signs tell you which is which. Have a good trip!
